notes: Easier-to-read alerts: wave, boss and event messages are now short, plain and big, with a dark backing so they stand out in a busy fight.
Every Summoner summon now has its own look: imps, archers, wraiths, hounds, familiars and the rest each have their own shape, size, colours and animation, so you can tell them apart at a glance.

XP now drops as gems you pick up, like in Vampire Survivors. Purple, blue, red and green gems are worth more as they go up. Bosses and elites drop a big gem. Your pickup radius, Magnet and vacuum all pull gems in.
The base pickup radius is bigger, and the level curve is back to normal, so levelling feels about the same as before if you collect your gems.
Levelling up in a run is about 20% slower after level 20 (each level past 20 needs 25% more XP). Levels 1 to 20 are as fast as before. Class levels and talent points are not affected.
Campfires no longer heal forever. Each one heals for a total of 5 seconds while you stand by it (the timer pauses when you step away), then burns out. A ring around the fire shows how much is left.
Old saves load fine. Spent campfires and gems on the ground are kept when you resume a run.
